questions.stem_text: Which of the following sets of bit strings CANNOT be described with a regular expression?

options.A: All bit strings whose number of zeros is a multiple of five
options.B: All bit strings starting with a zero and ending with a one
options.C: All bit strings with an even number of zeros
options.D: All bit strings with more ones than zeros

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: D - All bit strings with more ones than zeros

questions.stem_text:
Which of the following is NOT a reasonable justification for choosing to busy-wait on an
asynchronous event?

options.A: The wait is expected to be short.
options.B: A busy-wait loop is easier to code than an interrupt handler.
options.C: There is no other work for the processor to do.
options.D: The program executes on a time-sharing system.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: D - The program executes on a time-sharing system.

questions.stem_text:
Of the following, which gives the best upper bound for the value of f(N) where f is a
solution to the recurrence f(2N + 1) = f(2N) = f(N) + log N for N \textgreater{}= 1, with f(1) = 0?

In the Internet Protocol (IP) suite of protocols, which of the following best describes
the purpose of the Address Resolution Protocol?

options.A: To translate Web addresses to host names
options.B: To determine the IP address of a given host name
options.C: To determine the hardware address of a given host name
options.D: To determine the hardware address of a given IP address

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: D - To determine the hardware address of a given IP address

questions.stem_text: Which of the following is true of interrupts?

options.A: They are generated when memory cycles are "stolen".
options.B: They are used in place of data channels.
options.C: They can indicate completion of an I/O operation.
options.D: They cannot be generated by arithmetic operations.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: C - They can indicate completion of an I/O operation.
